visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young boy wearing a tan trench coat, a beret, and glasses sneaks through an indoor hallway with light-colored walls and wooden floors. He holds a magnifying glass and moves in a crouching, detective-like manner, looking around with focused eyes. (2) He bends down and discovers a white dental floss pick on the floor. He picks it up and performs an exaggerated sniffing action, closing his eyes in deep concentration. (3) The boy examines the floss pick as text labels appear on screen. He then smells the air with a confident, satisfied smile, adjusting his glasses. (4) In a brightly lit living room, a woman in a white sleeveless dress approaches the boy, looking distressed and holding a clean white plate. She gestures animatedly while talking to him. (5) The scene shifts to a modern kitchen where the woman points at a dishwasher and demonstrates how to load it. She shows a clean, sparkling glass to the camera. (6) The boy sniffs the white plate held by the woman, looking confused as he finds no trace of scent. (7) The woman holds up an orange box of 'Orange House' dishwasher tablets. She smiles brightly and speaks directly to the camera, pointing at the product features. (8) She demonstrates placing a small yellow and white rectangular tablet into the dishwasher's detergent compartment. Icons representing natural ingredients appear on screen. (9) The woman notices dark stains around the boy's mouth. The boy looks startled and sweaty. She jokingly attacks/hugs him on a sofa as they both laugh.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio starts with energetic, upbeat background music with a synthesized beat. High-pitched cartoonish 'boing' and 'zip' sound effects are synchronized with the boy's sneaking movements. (2) A sharp 'ding' and impact sound occurs when the boy finds the floss pick. He speaks in a fast, confident, and humorous Mandarin tone. (3) A woman's voice enters with a high-pitched, pleading, and exaggerated distressed tone. The music maintains its steady tempo. (4) The woman transitions to a clear, professional narrative style with a friendly and enthusiastic tone as she introduces the dishwasher product. (5) Audible clinking of dishes and a mechanical click of the dishwasher door are layered over the voice and BGM. (6) A short 'whoosh' transition sound plays. The boy speaks with a puzzled inflection. (7) The woman continues with high-energy speech, emphasizing key product benefits. (8) The video ends with a loud, high-pitched scream of 'Ah' followed by the sounds of playful wrestling and laughter over the upbeat music.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To promote Orange House dishwasher tablets by demonstrating their superior cleaning and deodorizing power through a humorous detective skit where a boy cannot smell food residue on an impeccably cleaned plate.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct display of the product box, detailed explanation of benefits, and demonstration of usage.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video successfully uses a narrative twist (the detective boy being the thief) to maintain engagement while delivering a product pitch.
